text: Thus says the Lord:For three crimes of Moab, and now four—I will not take it back—Because he burned to ashes [1]the bones of Edom's king,
I will send fire upon Moab,and it will devour the strongholds of Kerioth;Moab shall meet death amid uproar,battle cries and blasts of the ram's horn.
I will cut off the ruler from its midst,and all the princes I will slay with him, says the Lord.

[2] Thus says the Lord:For three crimes of Judah, and now four—I will not take it back—Because they spurned the instruction of the Lord, [AA]and did not keep his statutes;Because the lies [3] which their ancestors followedhave led them astray,
I will send fire upon Judah,and it will devour the strongholds of Jerusalem.
Thus says the Lord:For three crimes of Israel, [4] and now four—I will not take it back—Because they hand over the just for silver,and the poor for a pair of sandals; [AB]
They trample the heads of the destituteinto the dust of the earth,and force the lowly out of the way.Son and father sleep with the same girl, [5]profaning my holy name.
Upon garments taken in pledgethey recline beside any altar. [6] [AC]Wine at treasury expensethey drink in their temples.
Yet it was I who destroyed the Amorites before them,who were as tall as cedars,and as strong as oak trees.I destroyed their fruit aboveand their roots beneath. [AD]
It was I who brought you up from the land of Egypt,and who led you through the desert for forty years,to occupy the land of the Amorites;
I who raised up prophets among your children,and nazirites [7] among your young men.Is this not so, Israelites?—oracle of the Lord.
But you made the nazirites drink wine,and commanded the prophets, "Do not prophesy!" [AE]
Look, I am groaning beneath you,as a wagon groans when laden with sheaves.
Flight shall elude the swift,and the strong shall not retain strength; [AF]The warrior shall not save his life,
nor shall the archer stand his ground;The swift of foot shall not escape,nor shall the horseman save his life.
And the most stouthearted of warriorsshall flee naked on that day—oracle of the Lord.
